title: Dataset Management
summary: This module provides tools for defining, generating, and managing datasets used in evaluation and testing. It supports structured data generation and execution of evaluation tasks.

nodes.label: Define Dataset Schema
nodes.title: Dataset Definition
nodes.description: Defines the structure of a dataset, including input, output, and metadata types, along with optional evaluators.

nodes.label: Generate Dataset
nodes.title: Dataset Generation
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to generate synthetic test cases based on a defined dataset schema, ensuring compliance with specified types and schemas.

nodes.label: Execute Evaluation Task
nodes.title: Execute Evaluation Task
nodes.description: Manages the execution of a single evaluation task, including tracking its duration and output, within a controlled context.

nodes.label: AI Model Integration
nodes.title: AI Model Integration
nodes.description: Provides interfaces for interacting with various AI models, used here for generating dataset content.

groups.label: Dataset Lifecycle
groups.title: Dataset Lifecycle Management
groups.description: Handles the creation and structuring of evaluation datasets.

groups.label: Evaluation Runtime
groups.title: Evaluation Task Runtime
groups.description: Manages the execution context for individual evaluation tasks.
